8 registered interiors have access metadata and a physical exit; the V36 target is 8.
177 city interactions resolve to a quest, authored inspection, cited source, clue, or service; the V36 threshold is 70.
47 complete resident life chains are registered, including 10 three-stage social chains; targets are 30 life chains and 10 social chains.
85/85 declared environmental atlas tile GIDs are used in city maps; the V36 minimum is 60 distinct environment assets, and the ledger has 85 rows.
Map geography remains stylized and not georeferenced; cited records contextualize scenes but do not prove survey-grade in-game coordinates.
Local live-provider smoke does not verify the deployed Vercel production environment or its environment variables.
